# Two datasets {.center}

:seedling: Thirty minutes, with the welcome. One count table, one designed experiment.

{{< include sections/01-datasets.qmd >}}

# Twelve pitfalls {.center}

:triangular_ruler: About fifty minutes, including ten minutes to write your own PICO.

{{< include sections/02-pitfalls.qmd >}}

# When Y is not Gaussian {.center}

:microscope: About seventy minutes. QQ plots, transformations, three GLMs, then a smooth mean.

{{< include sections/03-non-gaussian.qmd >}}

{{< include sections/03b-smoothing.qmd >}}

# Nonlinear regression {.center visibility="hidden"}

A named curve in the parameters. Hidden from the audience deck.

{{< include sections/03c-nonlinear.qmd >}}

# Experimental design {.center}

:abacus: Words, contrasts, designs, then a mixed model. Ten minutes on the units, then a short application after each block. The worked answer is SPRUCE, except for the contrasts, which use CA-SYS.

{{< include sections/04-design.qmd >}}

# Causal estimands {.center}

:balance_scale: Twenty minutes. Simpson, the DAG roles, and the network search. A Bayesian reading of the same mean is in the close.

{{< include sections/05-bayesian-causal.qmd >}}

# Quiz {.center}

:question: Fifteen questions on situations outside the two datasets, then the SAMPL draft.

{{< include sections/06-quiz.qmd >}}

# Reproducibility {.center}

:repeat: A reference stack. One source file, then the practices that keep a rerun honest.

{{< include sections/07-reproducibility.qmd >}}

# Close {.center}

:white_check_mark: What to open next, then the room.

{{< include sections/08-close.qmd >}}
